artists.source_line: HUGO SMILE & EVREN KABACIOGLU are proud to announce the 10TH CONTRATEMPO.

features.rationale: The description states that more than 22 hours of workshops are included, so dance classes are part of the event.
The listed venue areas include an Afro room and a main room, so there is more than one dance room.
The event has four themed parties during the weekend.

features.quote: Free shuttle between the hotels and the venue of the event
features.rationale: A free shuttle runs between the partner hotels and the event venue.
